title: VantaHome — Core Awakening

1–4 seconds: An elegant magnetic EXPLODED VIEW. Roof and chimney lift together as one full-sized solid piece, the intact V glides FORWARD toward the camera, the house outline retreats behind, and the rounded-square glass backing separates into two full-sized parallel plates. All pieces remain present, fully visible and the same size, with large readable gaps in actual depth. No piece dissolves, disappears, shrinks or turns into particles. The core rings unfold into a tiny three-axis gyroscope, rotating independently around the glowing heart. Exactly four nodes remain connected by fine violet light filaments. A single soft, transparent wave of violet refraction ripples outward through the suspended pieces, bending their reflections on the floor. Strong depth parallax, rich light through bevelled crystal, beautiful calm tension. This is the hero moment.
6–9.5 seconds: The core draws the constellation back in. Solid components accelerate gently along distinct curved paths, then decelerate with satisfying mechanical precision. Backing plates reunite, house frame seats, V locks in, roof and chimney settle together. Core rings nest into their original concentric arrangement. One low luminous pulse travels around the reunited silhouette.
9.5–12 seconds: Camera resolves to the supplied original three-quarter hero composition. Hold the complete recognizable VantaHome icon for two full seconds, suspended above its crisp violet reflection. Core breathes softly; highlight fades. Final frame matches the supplied end image.

Visual language: high-budget photorealistic CGI, real optical refraction, machined purple titanium within crystal, polished obsidian, velvet blacks, restrained blue accents, shallow floor haze, rich but controlled glow, perfectly smooth camera, crisp geometry with cinematic motion blur. Dramatic spatial movement with elegant pacing. The silhouette and right-side chimney remain faithful to the reference.

Original synchronized audio: soft sub-bass heartbeat, glass singing and precise magnetic ticks on separation, airy spatial swell during the gyroscope, satisfying deep assembly click, delicate resolving electronic chime. No speech, lyrics or recognizable music.

No added text or logos, no fragments or explosions, no duplicated symbols, no melted geometry, no generic zoom-only animation, no flat sticker or screen, no hard cuts, no objects cropped by frame, no harsh strobe.
